# Test fixtures

`tone.wav` is a 0.2-second 440 Hz sine at 0.6 amplitude, generated by the
script in `decode.rs`'s tests rather than recorded. The other two are that
file, converted:

```
ffmpeg -i tone.wav -metadata LOOPSTART=1000 -metadata LOOPLENGTH=3000 -c:a flac tone.flac
ffmpeg -i tone.wav -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 64k tone.mp3
```

They are committed rather than generated at test time because a test that
needs ffmpeg on the machine running it is a test that does not run on most
machines. They are a few kilobytes, and nothing in them came from anywhere
but this repository.

The FLAC carries `LOOPSTART`/`LOOPLENGTH` tags on purpose: reading those is
the only way a FLAC can say what a WAV says in its `smpl` chunk, and the
test that checks it needs a file that has them.
